```python
class IncMerkle:
    """RFC 6962-style incremental tree. Leaves are pre-hashed."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.stack = {}      # height -> subtree root (present iff bit set in self.n)
        self.n = 0

    @staticmethod
    def leaf(entry: bytes) -> bytes:
        return sha256(b"\x00" + entry).digest()

    def push(self, leafhash: bytes) -> bytes:
        cur, h = leafhash, 0
        self.n += 1
        while self.n % (1 << (h + 1)) == 0:
            cur = sha256(b"\x01" + self.stack[h] + cur).digest()
            del self.stack[h]
            h += 1
        self.stack[h] = cur
        return self.root()

    def root(self) -> bytes:
        if self.n == 0:
            return sha256(b"").digest()
        heights = sorted(self.stack, reverse=True)
        acc = self.stack[heights[0]]
        for h in heights[1:]:
            acc = sha256(b"\x01" + self.stack[h] + acc).digest()
        return acc
```
